scenario_description: Elena has registered for an optional Saturday teaching workshop and plans to drive there, then stop at a teacher-supply store to collect a prepaid order needed for a later classroom assignment. The store confirms the order is ready, and a coworker later says she will already be near that store and can bring the order to Elena's school. The opportunity becomes sufficiently observable at event4: Elena could avoid a separate supply-store trip by authorizing the coworker to collect the order, but doing so requires coordinating with both the store and coworker. Event5 confirms the store's release requirement and pickup window, making timely coordination worthwhile while the workshop and assignment remain optional.

parameter.subject: Registration confirmed: Saturday classroom technology workshop
parameter.body: Your registration is confirmed for the optional classroom technology workshop on Saturday, April 18, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 11:30 AM at the Columbus Education Center, 2700 Cleveland Avenue. In your registration, you indicated that you plan to drive and bring your laptop. Attendance is not required for any substitute assignment.

parameter.subject: Pickup timing for prepaid classroom supply order
parameter.body: I plan to stop at your North High Street store after my April 18 workshop to collect my prepaid classroom supply order. The order is under Elena Brooks and includes two boxes of dry-erase markers and one document camera stand. Please let me know when it will be ready and how long you can hold it.

parameter.subject: Your classroom supply order is ready
parameter.body: Your prepaid order is ready for pickup at our North High Street store, 1880 N High Street, Columbus, Ohio. The two marker boxes and document camera stand are packaged together under Elena Brooks. We can hold the package through Saturday, April 18, during store hours of 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

parameter.subject: I can bring your supply order to school
parameter.body: I will be near Buckeye Teacher Supply on North High Street after my Friday, April 17 afternoon meeting, and I am driving back to Dominion Middle School afterward. If the store will release your prepaid package to me, I can bring it to Room 214 and save you the extra stop after Saturday's workshop. Let me know whether you want me to do that.

parameter.subject: Third-party pickup instructions for your order
parameter.body: A different person may collect your prepaid order if we receive written authorization naming that person before pickup. The authorized person must show photo identification and give the order name, Elena Brooks. The package will remain available until 5:00 PM Saturday, April 18, but any Friday pickup must occur before our 6:00 PM closing time.
